_note: FROM-pricing model, set by the client 2026-08-11. Rates are starting rates: the final figure is set at quote once the design is specified, because a geometric border, a full all-over geometric and a design with custom elements genuinely cost different amounts to make. Every rate MUST be presented with 'from' in front of it — a bare '£600/m²' is a price claim the business cannot stand behind, and under the DMCC Act 2024 a headline price that is rarely obtainable is drip pricing. The from-price must be genuinely achievable.

rateNote: The starting rate for the tier. Your final rate is confirmed at quote, once we know the design — a border, an all-over pattern and a design with custom elements take different amounts of work.
designFeeNote: Applies only if you ask us to assign a designer. Credited in full against your commission. If you take the design and do not proceed, the £200 is all you pay.
shippingNote: Shipping is included and fully insured to the UK, Europe and the United States for most commissions. Exceptionally large or heavy pieces may carry an additional freight charge, passed on at cost and confirmed with you at quote, before you commit. For delivery elsewhere, contact us to confirm delivery to your country.
customsNote: Import duties and destination VAT are payable by the recipient on arrival.
